title: Falling appart after ONE wash!
text:
Falling appart after ONE wash!. Based on the great five stars reviews I bought two. I had ordered them in gray but was told that they could send me the black ones instead. They were persistent in the way they wrote their message to me so I ended up agreeing to the black ones. Not my choice. Was told I'd receive a discount on the gray ones when they came back in stock. A long time has passed and the gray ones never came back in stock.

However, in the end it is absolutely irrelevant because I'd never purchase these blankets again.

Washed them in the gentle cycle and both blankets came out a mess and coming apart (the blankets are comprised of two types of material sewn together).

The feel of the blanket is soft and the design is pretty. On paper a great idea but the execution was very poor.

I have bought blankets for our cats and dogs for $10 and they are just as soft and warm and have outlasted these blankets (which I paid $49) by more than a year and tons of washes in the regular cycle of the washing mashine.

I am not sure who wrote all the five stars reviews but buyer beware. I would NOT recommend purchasing these blankets.
